rows.sql: SELECT weight FROM Pets WHERE PetType = 'dog' AND pet_age = (SELECT MIN(pet_age) FROM Pets WHERE PetType = 'dog');
SELECT PetType, MAX(weight) AS max_weight FROM Pets GROUP BY PetType
SELECT DISTINCT s.Fname FROM Student s JOIN Has_Pet hp ON s.StuID = hp.StuID JOIN Pets p ON p.PetID = hp.PetID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.PetType) = 2
SELECT DISTINCT s.Major, s.Age FROM Student s WHERE s.StuID NOT IN (SELECT hp.StuID FROM Has_Pet hp JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID WHERE p.PetType = 'cat')
SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE StuID NOT IN (SELECT hp.StuID FROM Has_Pet hp JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID WHERE p.PetType = 'cat')
SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE StuID NOT IN (SELECT hp.StuID FROM Has_Pet hp JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID WHERE p.PetType = 'cat' AND hp.StuID IS NOT NULL);
SELECT PetType, AVG(pet_age) AS avg_age, MAX(pet_age) AS max_age FROM Pets GROUP BY PetType;
SELECT PetType, AVG(weight) AS average_weight FROM Pets GROUP BY PetType;
SELECT DISTINCT s.Fname, s.Age FROM Student s WHERE s.StuID IN (SELECT StuID FROM Has_Pet) ORDER BY s.Fname, s.Age;
SELECT DISTINCT s.LName FROM Student s JOIN Has_Pet hp ON s.StuID = hp.StuID JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID WHERE p.PetType = 'cat' AND p.pet_age = 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count FROM countries;
SELECT cn.Model, cd.Weight, cn.Make FROM cars_data cd JOIN car_names cn ON cn.MakeId = cd.Id WHERE cd.Weight < (SELECT AVG(Weight) FROM cars_data) ORDER BY cd.Weight LIMIT 50
SELECT DISTINCT cm.Maker, cm.FullName FROM car_makers cm JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id JOIN car_names cn ON cn.Model = ml.Model JOIN cars_data cd ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId WHERE cd.Year = 1970;

SELECT c.Continent, COUNT(m.Id) AS maker_count FROM continents c LEFT JOIN countries co ON co.Continent = c.ContId LEFT JOIN car_makers m ON m.Country = co.CountryId GROUP BY c.ContId, c.Continent ORDER BY c.Continent;
SELECT AVG(CAST(MPG AS REAL)) AS avg_mpg FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 4;
SELECT MIN(Weight) AS min_weight FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 8 AND Year = 1974;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_cars FROM cars_data WHERE CAST(Horsepower AS INTEGER) > 150;
SELECT AVG(CAST(Horsepower AS REAL)) AS avg_horsepower FROM cars_data WHERE Year < 1980 AND Horsepower GLOB '[0-9]*';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.Model) AS model_count FROM model_list m JOIN car_makers c ON m.Maker = c.Id WHERE c.FullName = 'American Motor Company';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS model_count FROM model_list ml JOIN car_makers cm ON ml.Maker = cm.Id WHERE cm.FullName = 'American Motor Company';

SELECT cn.MakeId, cn.Make FROM cars_data cd JOIN car_names cn ON cn.MakeId = cd.Id WHERE CAST(cd.Horsepower AS INTEGER) > (SELECT MIN(CAST(Horsepower AS INTEGER)) FROM cars_data) AND cd.Cylinders < 4;

SELECT m.Id, m.Maker
FROM car_makers m
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_list ml WHERE ml.Maker = m.Id) >= 2
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*)
       FROM cars_data cd
       JOIN car_names cn ON cn.MakeId = cd.Id
       JOIN model_list ml2 ON ml2.Model = cn.Model
       WHERE ml2.Maker = m.Id) > 3;
SELECT Airline, Abbreviation FROM airlines WHERE Country = 'USA';
SELECT AirportCode, AirportName FROM airports WHERE City = 'Anthony';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS number_of_flights FROM flights;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS flights_arriving_in_aberdeen FROM flights f JOIN airports a ON TRIM(f.DestAirport) = TRIM(a.AirportCode) WHERE TRIM(a.City) = 'Aberdeen'

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT a.AirportCode,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights f
          WHERE TRIM(f.SourceAirport) = TRIM(a.AirportCode)
             OR TRIM(f.DestAirport) = TRIM(a.AirportCode)) AS n
  FROM airports a
)
SELECT AirportCode, n AS flight_count
FROM counts
WHERE n = (SELECT MIN(n) FROM counts);
SELECT f.FlightNo FROM flights f JOIN airlines a ON f.Airline = a.uid WHERE a.Airline = 'United Airlines' ORDER BY f.FlightNo;
SELECT FlightNo, Airline FROM flights WHERE TRIM(DestAirport) = 'APG'
SELECT f.FlightNo FROM flights f JOIN airports a ON TRIM(f.DestAirport) = TRIM(a.AirportCode) WHERE TRIM(a.City) = 'Aberdeen'
SELECT District FROM shop GROUP BY District HAVING SUM(Number_products < 3000) > 0 AND SUM(Number_products > 10000) > 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Location) AS distinct_locations FROM shop;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Template_ID) AS number_of_templates_used FROM Documents;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS document_count FROM Documents d JOIN Templates t ON d.Template_ID = t.Template_ID WHERE t.Template_Type_Code = 'PPT'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS document_count FROM Documents d JOIN Templates t ON d.Template_ID = t.Template_ID WHERE t.Template_Type_Code = 'PPT';
SELECT t.Template_ID FROM Templates t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Documents d WHERE d.Template_ID = t.Template_ID) ORDER BY t.Template_ID LIMIT 50
SELECT DISTINCT Template_Type_Code FROM Templates;
SELECT Template_Type_Description FROM Ref_Template_Types WHERE Template_Type_Code = 'AD';
SELECT Template_Type_Code FROM Ref_Template_Types WHERE Template_Type_Description = 'Book';

SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, COUNT(p.Paragraph_ID) AS Paragraph_Count FROM Documents d LEFT JOIN Paragraphs p ON p.Document_ID = d.Document_ID GROUP BY d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name ORDER BY d.Document_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) AS teacher_count FROM teacher;
SELECT t.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.Course_ID) AS Course_Count FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN course_arrange ca ON ca.Teacher_ID = t.Teacher_ID GROUP BY t.Teacher_ID, t.Name ORDER BY t.Name;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS museum_count FROM museum WHERE CAST(Open_Year AS INTEGER) > 2013 OR CAST(Open_Year AS INTEGER) < 2008;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_players FROM players;
SELECT first_name, birth_date FROM players WHERE country_code = 'USA' LIMIT 50;
SELECT AVG(winner_rank) AS avg_winner_rank FROM matches;
SELECT MIN(loser_rank) AS highest_rank_of_losers FROM matches WHERE loser_rank IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loser_name) AS distinct_loser_names FROM matches;
SELECT p.first_name, p.country_code FROM rankings r JOIN players p ON p.player_id = r.player_id GROUP BY r.player_id ORDER BY SUM(r.tours) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH wins AS (
  SELECT winner_id, COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM matches
  WHERE winner_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY winner_id
),
top AS (
  SELECT winner_id, wins FROM wins ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1
),
latest AS (
  SELECT m.winner_id, m.winner_name, m.winner_rank_points
  FROM matches m
  JOIN top t ON m.winner_id = t.winner_id
  ORDER BY m.tourney_date DESC, m.match_num DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT l.winner_name AS name, t.wins AS matches_won, l.winner_rank_points AS rank_points
FROM top t JOIN latest l ON l.winner_id = t.winner_id;
SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM players GROUP BY country_code ORDER BY player_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT note FROM death WHERE note LIKE '%East%'
SELECT line_1, line_2 FROM Addresses LIMIT 50
SELECT section_name, section_description FROM Sections LIMIT 50;

SELECT d.degree_summary_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS num_students
FROM Student_Enrolment e
JOIN Degree_Programs d ON e.degree_program_id = d.degree_program_id
GROUP BY d.degree_summary_name
ORDER BY num_students DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.semester_name FROM Semesters s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Student_Enrolment e WHERE e.semester_id = s.semester_id);
SELECT cell_mobile_number FROM Students WHERE first_name = 'Timmothy' AND last_name = 'Ward';
SELECT first_name FROM Students WHERE permanent_address_id IS NOT NULL AND current_address_id IS NOT NULL AND permanent_address_id <> current_address_id LIMIT 50
SELECT datetime(AVG(julianday(transcript_date))) AS average_transcript_date FROM Transcripts;
SELECT MAX(transcript_date) AS last_transcript_date FROM Transcripts;

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT t.transcript_id, t.transcript_date, COUNT(tc.student_course_id) AS result_count
  FROM Transcripts t
  LEFT JOIN Transcript_Contents tc ON tc.transcript_id = t.transcript_id
  GROUP BY t.transcript_id, t.transcript_date
)
SELECT transcript_id, transcript_date, result_count
FROM counts
WHERE result_count = (SELECT MIN(result_count) FROM counts);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT current_address_id) AS distinct_current_addresses FROM Students WHERE current_address_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT student_id, current_address_id, permanent_address_id, first_name, middle_name, last_name, cell_mobile_number, email_address, date_first_registered, date_left, other_student_details FROM Students ORDER BY first_name DESC, last_name DESC;

SELECT SUM(Population) AS total_population FROM city WHERE District = 'Gelderland';

SELECT c.Name FROM country c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage l WHERE l.CountryCode = c.Code AND l.Language = 'English') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage l WHERE l.CountryCode = c.Code AND l.Language = 'French') ORDER BY c.Name;

SELECT c.Name FROM country c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage l WHERE l.CountryCode = c.Code AND l.Language = 'English' AND l.IsOfficial = 'T') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage l WHERE l.CountryCode = c.Code AND l.Language = 'French' AND l.IsOfficial = 'T') ORDER BY c.Name

SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS num_cities_above_average FROM city WHERE Population > (SELECT AVG(Population) FROM city) GROUP BY District ORDER BY num_cities_above_average DESC;
SELECT Continent, AVG(LifeExpectancy) AS avg_life_expectancy, SUM(Population) AS total_population FROM country GROUP BY Continent HAVING AVG(LifeExpectancy) < 72;

SELECT Name FROM city WHERE Population BETWEEN 160000 AND 900000 LIMIT 50;

SELECT DISTINCT c.Name FROM conductor c JOIN orchestra o ON o.Conductor_ID = c.Conductor_ID WHERE o.Year_of_Founded > 2008
SELECT grade, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM Highschooler GROUP BY grade HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM Highschooler GROUP BY grade))
SELECT name FROM Highschooler WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM Friend WHERE student_id IS NOT NULL);
SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name, p.last_name FROM Professionals p JOIN Treatments t ON t.professional_id = p.professional_id WHERE t.cost_of_treatment < (SELECT AVG(cost_of_treatment) FROM Treatments);
SELECT role_code, street, city, state FROM Professionals WHERE city LIKE '%West%' LIMIT 50
SELECT age FROM Dogs WHERE CAST(age AS REAL) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(age AS REAL)) FROM Dogs);
SELECT charge_type, charge_amount FROM Charges ORDER BY charge_type;

SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name, tt.treatment_type_description FROM Treatments t JOIN Professionals p ON t.professional_id = p.professional_id JOIN Treatment_Types tt ON t.treatment_type_code = tt.treatment_type_code LIMIT 50
rows.review: The query returns duplicate first_name/description pairs (e.g., Monte with "Take for a Walk" appears twice), so it lists each treatment per treatment record rather than each professional's treatment descriptions. Use `SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name, tt.treatment_type_description ...` to return each pair once.
